# RaggieSoft Installer Studio (Install Without Limits) — v0.9.1

> First-party, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 Windows packaging suite (`InstallerStudio.exe` 12-view Visual IDE + 6 Guided AeroWizards, `instbuild.exe` CLI compiler & JSON linter, `SetupWizard.exe` 11-style WCAG 2.2 AA runtime wizard, `msiprism.exe` 64-bit MSI/MSM/MST/MSP SQL inspector, and `RaggieSoftHelp.exe` native offline Help Viewer) targeting Windows 11 `x64` and `ARM64`. Official portal: https://raggiesoftstudio.com | Editions Matrix: https://raggiesoftstudio.com/installer-studio/editions | Open-source dev hub: https://raggiesoft.dev

## Hybrid Project Architecture (`.rsip` + `.rsis` + `.rsii` + `.rssc`)
- **`.rsip` (*RaggieSoft Installer Project*)**: 100% standalone single-file INI-style project manifest (similar to a standalone `.csproj`).
- **`.rsis` (*RaggieSoft Installer Suite*)**: Optional multi-project workspace (similar to `.slnx`) with `[Suite]`, `[Variable]`, and ordered `[Project.<Id>]` entries.
- **`.rsii` (*RaggieSoft Installer Include*)**: Optional `@include "shared.rsii"` header inherited losslessly across projects.
- **`.rssc` (*RaggieScript* — `v0.7.0`)**: Modern C#/TypeScript-style curly-brace native scripting language compiling to `RSWBC1` bytecode for zero-MSI setups (standalone `.rssc` or hybrid `.rsip` + `ScriptFile = setup.rssc`).

## Official Four Editions & Offline Cryptographic `.rswlic` Licensing (`No License File == Community`)
- **No `.rswlic` License File == Community Edition (`Community == 100% Architect Parity`)**: Free for hobbyists, solo creators, open-source maintainers, students, educators, and non-profits—presented automatically whenever no `.rswlic` file is installed, 100% unlocked with zero watermarks (`VERSIONINFO` & wizard footers belong 100% to `[Package] Manufacturer`).
- **Commercial `.rswlic` Licenses (`Essentials` • `Developer` • `Architect`)**: Verified 100% offline via Windows `System32\bcrypt.dll` (`BCRYPT_ECDSA_P256_ALGORITHM`) across `--license-file=<file.rswlic>`, `RSW_LICENSE_KEY`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\RaggieSoft\Licenses\`, and `%PROGRAMDATA%\RaggieSoft\Licenses\` with zero telemetry and zero hardware lock-in.

## Why Comment-Preserving `.rsip` Excels for AI Coding Agents & Git
- **Zero Backslash Escaping**: Write Windows paths naturally (`DefaultSubdir = Sample Studio\My App`) with full `;` and `#` inline/block comments.
- **Minimal Token Footprint**: Clean `[Section]` and `[Prefix.<Id>]` blocks without verbose XML closing tags.
- **100% Lossless IDE Parity & White-Label Output**: `InstallerStudio.exe` preserves every comment and `@include` byte-for-byte, and Community Edition maintains 100% feature parity with Architect Edition with zero UI watermarks.

## Core CLI Commands (`instbuild.exe`, `msiprism.exe`, & `RaggieSoftHelp.exe`)
- `instbuild.exe --validate --diagnostics=json <project.rsip|suite.rsis> [--arch=x64|arm64]`: Sub-millisecond schema, GUID, 3-part MSI version, Component rule (`RSW031`/`RSW032`), filesystem, and `&` mnemonic linter.
- `instbuild.exe <project.rsip|suite.rsis> [--arch=x64|arm64] [--universal] [--category=<cat>] [--project=<id>] [--with-vpat]`: Compiles standalone Enterprise `<OutputName>.msi` + LZMS-compressed `<OutputName>-setup.exe`—plus combined Universal Single-File outputs (`<UniversalOutputName>-offline-setup.exe` with x64+ARM64 in one EXE, and `<UniversalOutputName>-setup.exe` CPU-aware WinHTTP Web Stub) when `BuildUniversal = true` or `--universal` is passed.
- `instbuild.exe --emit-vpat <project.rsip> <out-dir>`: Generates an audited WCAG 2.2 AA & Revised Section 508 HTML5 VPAT 2.5 Conformance Report.
- `instbuild.exe --emit-msm <project.rsip> <out.msm> [--arch=x64|arm64]`: Compiles a 64-bit Windows Installer Merge Module (`.msm`).
- `instbuild.exe --generate-mst <base.msi> <target.msi> <out.mst>`: Generates a GPO Transform (`.mst`).
- `instbuild.exe --generate-msp <base.msi> <upgraded.msi> <out.msp>`: Generates a Patch Package (`.msp`).
- `instbuild.exe --verify-msi <file.msi>`: Runs SQL & ICE80 64-bit consistency checks on a compiled `.msi`.
- `instbuild.exe --emit-ai-spec <dir>`: Regenerates `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `SKILL.md`.
- `msiprism.exe [--inspect-summary] <file.msi|msm|msp>`: Inspects any Windows Installer database in RaggieSoft MSI Prism.
- `RaggieSoftHelp.exe [--module raggiesoft.installer-studio] [--topic <id>]`: Opens the offline C++20 Help Viewer.
- `<product>-setup.exe --extract-msi <dir>`: Extracts the embedded `Product.msi` for enterprise deployment.

## `.rsip` Manifest Sections (`v0.9`)
- `[Package]`: Core product identity, PackageKind (msi/msm/sfx/addon/suite), Engine (msi/raggiescript-msi/raggiescript), Script (.rssc), UAC execution level, SuiteRollbackPolicy, target CPU architecture (x64/arm64), and universal output settings.
- `[RaggieScript]`: Optional RaggieScript (.rssc) configuration ([RaggieScript] Source = setup.rssc) for RaggieScript MSI (Engine = raggiescript-msi) wizard orchestration and inside-the-MSI Custom Actions.
- `[CustomAction.<id>]`: Declares a native inside-the-MSI RaggieScript Custom Action ([CustomAction.<id>]: immediate, deferred, rollback, or commit) executed via embedded static /MT RsscMsiCa.dll with full msiexec /qn GPO parity and atomic rollback.
- `[HostApp]`: Host application discovery & automatic content placement rules ([HostApp]) for PackageKind = addon (locates an installed Host App such as Book Reader or Listening Room via UpgradeCode/Registry/Executable and places books, albums, plugins, or DLC into the right directory with zero full-installer ceremony).
- `[Requirements]`: Minimum Windows 11 build gate (RtlGetVersion & MSI LaunchCondition), downgrade protection, and silent reboot exit code.
- `[Upgrade]`: Declarative update & servicing policy ([Upgrade]): Strategy (major|minor|small_hotfix), RemoveExistingProducts Schedule (early 1525 vs late 6550), MigrateFeatures (257), BaselineMsi, and RsUpdate.exe UpdateFeedUrl.
- `[Install]`: Default installation subfolder under ProgramFiles64Folder/LocalAppDataFolder and Start Menu group (optional when PackageKind = sfx or suite).
- `[Media]`: Multi-volume cabinet disk spanning (MaxCabinetSizeMB -> CAB1.cab..CABN.cab), external vs. embedded cabinets, and uncompressed loose source media (Compression = none | cab).
- `[SFX]`: Lightweight LZMS self-extracting archive (.exe) post-extraction launch (PostExtractRun), document open (PostExtractOpen), temp staging, and folder options (PackageKind = sfx).
- `[UI]`: Branding, RTF license, icon, 11 selectable C++ WizardLayout styles (including 'simple' ultra-compact single-dialog mode, Wizard95, FluentMica, FullScreenBlue & ACME FullScreenTeal), SetupTypePreset, and MSI.DLL dialog workflow.
- `[Signing]`: Optional dual-layer Authenticode / Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Product.msi first, then outer Setup.exe) via signtool.exe.
- `[SetupType.<id>]`: Custom author-defined setup mode card ([SetupType.<id>]: Typical, Compact, Complete, Developer Workstation, etc.) with '&' mnemonic, description, feature tier, and icon.
- `[Billboard.<id>]`: Optional rotating feature highlight card ([Billboard.<id>]) displayed during installation on FullScreenBlue, FullScreenTeal, and progress views.
- `[Prerequisite.<id>]`: Runtime prerequisite ([Prerequisite.<id>]: .NET 11, .NET 10 LTS, WebView2, VC++ Redist, or Custom .exe/.msi) executed BEFORE msiexec with download/embedded/side-by-side delivery and reboot exit-code tracking.
- `[SuitePackage.<id>]`: Child .msi or RaggieScript EXE setup package ([SuitePackage.<id>]) chained under a single UAC prompt in Unified Suite Setup (PackageKind = suite) with dynamic ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT adoption.
- `[MergeModule.<id>]`: Consumes a Windows Installer Merge Module ([MergeModule.<id>]: .msm) merging its Components, Files, Registry, and MergeModule.CABinet directly into Product.msi.
- `[Feature.<id>]`: Named Feature or Sub-Feature ([Feature.<id>]) with plain-English Inclusion tiers, optional Run-from-Source (MenuCD/MenuNetwork), and embedded vs. external .rswpak on-demand delivery.
- `[Component.<id>]`: Explicit MSI Component ([Component.<id>]) enforcing Microsoft Single-Directory & KeyPath rules (File, Registry, or CreateFolder).
- `[Folder.<id>]`: Creates a destination subdirectory ([Folder.<id>]) via MSI CreateFolder + ICE64 RemoveFolder cleanup.
- `[Payload.<id>]`: Maps a build-machine file, directory, or .zip archive ([Payload.<id>]) into #payload.cab / RSWPAK1 and deterministic or explicit Components.
- `[FileAssociation.<id>]`: Registers a file extension, ProgId, document icon, MIME type, and Explorer shell verbs ([FileAssociation.<id>]).
- `[Shortcut.<id>]`: Creates an advertised-free Start Menu or Desktop shortcut ([Shortcut.<id>]) with ICE38 HKCU KeyPath & ICE64 RemoveFolder.
- `[Registry.<id>]`: Writes an HKLM/HKCU/HKCR/HKMU registry value ([Registry.<id>]) tied to an auto or explicit 64-bit MSI Component.
- `[Environment.<id>]`: Configures a user or system Environment Variable ([Environment.<id>]), including non-clobbering PATH append/prepend with exact uninstall removal across MSI & RaggieScript EXE.
- `[IniFile.<id>]`: Writes or updates a [Section] Key = Value entry inside a target .ini configuration file ([IniFile.<id>]) across MSI & RaggieScript EXE.
- `[Dialog.<id>]`: Defines a custom C++ SetupWizard.exe page ([Dialog.<id>]) edited in the WYSIWYG Visual Dialog Designer and spliced into the runtime setup flow.
- `[Control.<id>]`: Places a Per-Monitor V2 DPI Win32 control ([Control.<id>]: Label, Edit, PathEdit, CheckBox, RadioGroup, ComboBox, GroupBox) onto a custom C++ [Dialog.<id>] page.
- `[MsiDialog.<id>]`: Defines a custom 370x270 Windows Installer SQL Dialog ([MsiDialog.<id>]) spliced into the MSI.DLL UI sequence.
- `[MsiControl.<id>]`: Adds a native MSI control ([MsiControl.<id>]: Text, Edit, CheckBox, RadioButtonGroup, etc.) to a new or built-in MSI Dialog.
